recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed unless a future terminology reconciliation finds that THO diverged from the FHIR-8647 flag-category concepts.
issue_request: FHIR-8647 was a Published Patient Care change request asking the Flag.category example value set to add clinical, behavioral, research, advance-directive, and safety while excluding vague Other and Special Circumstances concepts. The final resolution also made Flag.category 0..*, added a local-business-rules usage note, updated the scope sentence, changed the main example category to safety, and corrected the drug definition to refer to the subject's medications.
initial_application: Historical commit 0d80e1599c3bb751de22b8dc8fb6fa951b014c09 explicitly applied #8647 by updating the Flag spreadsheet cardinality/comment, adding the requested codes and drug wording to source/flag/codesystem-flag-category.xml, fixing source/flag/flag-introduction.xml, and changing source/flag/flag-example.xml to safety.
additional_context: The Flag resource is active in source/fhir.ini. The flag-category CodeSystem was later removed from core by 5c0494aacfd0b8bd52bc72c587aa89d0a64246f8 as part of moving UTG/THO content out of the core build. Current source/flag/valueset-flag-category.xml composes the THO flag-category CodeSystem, and current THO still contains the requested concepts and corrected drug definition. Community searches found no conflicting later decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current StructureDefinition has Flag.category 0..* with the usage note and example binding, the current introduction and example retain the requested wording/category changes, and the current external terminology source contains the requested codes.
